heading: Examinations
lead: In addition to inspections required by section 3307 of this title, the Secretary shall examine or have examined—

tree.text: each vessel subject to inspection at proper times to ensure compliance with law and regulations; and
crewmember accommodations on each vessel subject to inspection at least once a month or when the vessel enters United States ports to ensure that the accommodations are—

children.text: of the size required by law and regulations;
properly ventilated and in a clean and sanitary condition; and
equipped with proper plumbing and mechanical appliances required by law and regulations, and the appliances are in good working condition.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 330846:43546:660a46:660b Section 3308 requires the Secretary to carry out additional inspections as might be necessary to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations, and to ensure that accommodations are maintained in a sanitary condition and that all appliances are in good working order.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1996—Pub. L. 104–324 inserted “or have examined” after “examine” in introductory provisions.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Apr. 15, 1984, see section 2(g)(1) of Pub. L. 98–89, set out as a note under section 3101 of this title.
